headline: Officials previewed a draft FY2028 budget, with combined city and school spending up 8.46% to $415,265,700.
summary: Finance staff presented draft budgets for the city and school district, covering labor, benefits, debt service, and possible cuts to school spending. Salaries and benefits make up more than 70% of the general fund operating budget. Officials said the full budget will be built over the next few months, and many questions remain open.

A Special Meeting of the Board of Aldermen was held Tuesday, November 24, 2026, at 7:00 pm in the Aldermanic 
Chamber and duly noticed in two places, including the City’s website, in accordance with the requirements of RSA 91 -
A:2 II. 
   
President Lori Wilshire presided; City Clerk Daniel Healey recorded. 
 
Prayer was offered by City Clerk Daniel Healey; Alderman Patricia Klee, led in the Pledge to the Flag. 
 
Let’s start the meeting by taking a roll call attendance.   
 
The roll call was taken with 14 members of the Board of Aldermen present:  Alderman Clemons (arrived at 7:06 p.m.), 
Alderman Klee, Alderman Ravan, Alderwoman Smith, Alderman Thibeault, Alderman O’Brien, Alderman Gregg (via 
Zoom), Alderman Dowd (via Zoom), Alderman Sullivan, Alderman Sennott, Alderman Johnson, Alderwoman Kelly, 
Alderman Morgan, Alderman Wilshire.    
 
Alderman Lopez was were recorded absent. 
 
Mayor Jim Donchess and Corporation Counsel Steve Bolton were also in attendance. 
 
DISCUSSION AND/OR PRESENTATION 
• Nashua School District finances
